digest.component_or_area: CI test performance and Gerrit Verify workflow
propositions: An exhaustive audit of all Gerrit Verify CI tests exceeding one second duration is needed, mapping each slow phase to its unique failure mode, faster overlapping coverage, and safe remediation options.
Three recent successful CI runs spanning all four pytest cells must be identified and their run IDs, tested SHAs, completion times, and durations recorded as the baseline sample.

A local completeness pass using --durations=0 --durations-min=1.0 on macOS and default/integration selectors must enumerate every setup/call/teardown phase at or above 1.0s to capture phases below CI's top-25 rank.

An inventory union of all >=1.0s phases from CI logs and local completeness must be compiled with node IDs, durations, platform/Python cells, and provenance; CI phases below rank 25 remain unobservable.

Parameterized node groups and fixture families must be analyzed against ticket history, prior rejections, and OSS precedent to produce keep/refactor/move recommendations with projected macOS wall-clock and total runner savings.
No code, tests, workflows, CI dispatches, or ticket transitions are performed; the analysis is descriptive only and preserves real E2E/integration seams and platform-specific behavior.
